overlord_bark: Their whole winter, goblin. Stacked in one shed, in the middle of their village, guarded by men who believe that is clever.
hud_line: Granary: burn it — one of the three fires that flares the stones open for extraction. [Q] Torch toss.

overlord_bark: Ripe. Proud. Combustible. Put one spark in the rows and let it do the rest of my work for me.
hud_line: Wheat field: torch the crop — fire spreads row to row and is the hardest blaze in the hamlet to douse. [Q] Torch toss.

overlord_bark: The turning thing. It grinds their bread and their good opinion of themselves. Set fire to its frame.
hud_line: Windmill: any torch on the frame starts Stage 1 — Ablaze, the first half of the raid's biggest burn. [Q] Torch toss.

overlord_bark: Her skin's alight, goblin, but it's the dust in her belly that'll bring her down — put fire through a window.
hud_line: Windmill: Ablaze — needs a window shot; an aimed torch inside catches the grain dust and detonates the mill. [Q] Aim, then throw.

overlord_bark: Torchlight in the trees. Their own fire betrays them long before their eyes find you. Bend your knees, goblin.
hud_line: Patrol ahead: crouch to break their sightlines — a look must hold about 1.5 seconds to confirm you, and unconfirmed keeps the hamlet QUIET. [Crouch]

overlord_bark: You left the road empty, goblin. Even fools notice when a fool stops arriving.
hud_line: Soft signal filed: a second one while the hamlet is SUSPICIOUS escalates straight to RAID — stay unseen and it decays back to QUIET. [Crouch]

overlord_bark: He has not seen you. In this county that passes for a personality.
hud_line: Unaware human: hold from behind for a silent takedown — no shout, no bell, no witness. [Hold E]

overlord_bark: Do not waste her on a corpse, goblin. A corpse is five points and a shrug. I want them walking.
hud_line: Unarmed civilian: hold longer to bind instead — captives rope-chain home and bank permanently at the stones. [Hold E, longer channel]

overlord_bark: Their wealth, goblin. Their wealth has trotters. Take it over your shoulder and let it squeal.
hud_line: Pig pen: shoulder a live pig — 40 loot points, banked the instant it reaches the runic site. [Hold E]
